links.outcome: Treatment times and patient outcomes (90-day mRS, mortality) with vs without AI
links.effect: DTG time reduced by 11.2 min (95% CI -18.22 to -4.2); no difference in 90-day functional independence (OR 1.3; 95% CI 0.42-4.0); mortality 31% vs 13%.
links.quote: In multivariable logistic regression adjusted for age, NIHSS and ASPECTS, there was no observe a difference in likelihood of 90-day disability (mRS, 0-2) in the post-AI cohort relative to pre-AI (odds ratio, 1.3; 95% CI, 0.42-4.0).

unlisted_practices: Coupling AI imaging alerts with secure group messaging/mobile PACS for care-team coordination

links.outcome: Functional independence, mortality, and hospital length of stay versus standard care
links.effect: 90-day functional independence: odds ratio, 1.3; 95% CI, 0.42-4.0. Mortality: 31% pre-AI versus 13% post-AI; P <.001. No difference in hospital length of stay.
links.quote: The study team did not observe any differences in IV tPA treatment times, length of stay, rates of functional independence, or safety outcomes apart from mortality, which decreased after the AI intervention.

links.outcome: Time to thrombectomy after automated LVO detection and real-time clinical team alerts
links.effect: Door-to-groin time decreased by 11.2 minutes (95% CI, -18.22 to -4.2); CT initiation-to-EVT time decreased by 9.8 minutes (95% CI, -16.9 to -2.6).
links.quote: In mixed-effects linear regression, implementation of the AI algorithm was associated with a reduction in DTG time by 11.2 minutes (95% CI, -18.22 to -4.2).

unlisted_practices: Secure mobile group messaging and shared image viewing for multidisciplinary stroke-team coordination, evaluated as a bundle with automated LVO alerts.
